soldier: Soldier: the head shape occurs in a round and an elongate form. Head and antennae pale yellow, mandibles deep brown, abdomen greyish white. The dorsum of the head sparsely haired, the disc of the thoracic and abdominal tergites also sparsely haired, the margins slightly denser and arranged in rows; the labrum with two apical hairs and two lateral-apical hairs, the lateral-apical hairs sometimes absent; the fontanelle hairs mostly two on each side, occasionally three or one on one side. In the round form the dorsum of the head is circular, slightly contracted at the front, the fontanelle ridge trapezoidal, the fontanelle aperture semicircular and inclined backwards, arched in profile; the labrum longer than wide, elongate-triangular, with a transparent tip, evenly rounded and contracted on both sides at the base; mandibles sickle-shaped, their tips only slightly curved, the base of the left mandible with four faint tooth processes, the foremost at three-eighths of the total length from the base; antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest; postmentum broad, its anterior part evenly rounded and swollen on both sides, narrowest at four-sevenths from the base. Anterior margin of the pronotum concave in the middle, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle, the anterior lateral angles evenly rounded, the sides straight. In the elongate form the dorsum of the head is elongate-oval, narrower and longer than in the round form and higher in profile, the labrum longer, the postmentum narrow and long, narrowest at two-fifths from the base, the fontanelle narrower and higher.
